evals.prompt: Find the Codex session where we discussed the first mention of Itanos.
evals.expected_output: Search native Codex transcript text and return ranked sessions with snippets and resumable IDs.
expectations: Runs codex-tracker search with the topic as the query
Reports at least one matching session ID when a match exists
Includes the native matching snippet and working directory
Does not query Codex SQLite databases directly

evals.prompt: Show me my five most recent Codex sessions, including codex exec runs, as JSON.
evals.expected_output: Return machine-readable recent-session metadata from the native App Server.
expectations: Returns valid JSON without ANSI control sequences

evals.prompt: Within Codex session 01a00000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000, find every visible occurrence of ‘permission profile’.
evals.expected_output: Use native in-session occurrence search and report matching turn/item identifiers and snippets.
expectations: Runs codex-tracker occurrences with the supplied session ID and phrase
Does not resume or mutate the session

evals.prompt: Search this repository for where Codex session state is implemented.
evals.expected_output: Do not invoke the session-tracker skill because this is project source-code search.
expectations: Uses ordinary repository search tools instead
